summary: Collection sockets reread only the windows whose inputs changed, and published views only when they publish

replay.detail: Collection refresh scheduling changes only; claim admission and replay are unchanged.

schema.detail: Pending rereads and publication revisions are kept in memory. No database schema or persistent state changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; no coordinated member upgrade is required.

compatibility.detail: The collection protocol, authorization checks, snapshot fences, current-row diffs and reconnect behavior are unchanged. A commit rereads only the windows its claim kinds can change; a failed read retries its own window. Agents windows reread when the roster refresher publishes, which such a commit now asks it to do, rather than first rereading the roster already held. Unix sessions reread only clock-dependent windows (attention, missions, agents, summary) on the 30-second clock; paired sessions still reread every window so grant expiry is noticed.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption beyond a normal daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action or client configuration change is needed.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes or new binary swap-back restrictions.
